senses.gloss:
भज् भज्, cl. 1. P. A. भजति, -ते, ब-
भाज (2nd sing. बभक्थ or भेजिथ,
3rd pl. भेजुस्), भेजे (part. भेजान), भक्ष्यति,
-ते (in later Sanskrit also भजिष्यति, -ते), अभा-
क्षीत्, अभक्त, भक्षीष्ट, (Vedic forms are,
2nd sing. impv. भक्षि, अभाक्, अभाक्त, भ-
क्षत), भक्तुम् (ep. also भजितुम्), to assign,
allot, apportion, dispense, distribute; to share, divide
(e. g. भजेरन् पैतृकं रिक्थम्, they may divide
the property of their father); to grant, bestow; to
supply, furnish, provide (Ved.); to receive as a por-
tion, obtain as one's share (A.), share in, partake of
(with acc. and in the earlier language also with gen.);
to obtain, get, take for one's self (A.); take posses-
sion of, recover; to enjoy, possess, have; to enjoy
carnally; to embrace (A.); to be devoted to, betake
one's self to, resort to, have recourse to, go to, fre-
quent (with acc.); to come to, turn towards any
one (with acc.); to favour (A.); prefer, choose,
elect; decide in favour of, declare for; to serve,
honour, revere, worship, adore, esteem, wait upon,
attend upon; to be attached to, love, court (affection);
to fall to the lot of any one (acc.); to apply one's
self to, pursue, practise, cultivate, be engaged in;
to cook, dress (food); to employ, engage. The
above meanings of भज् may be variously extended
by connecting it with nouns, e. g. पत्नीम् भज्, to
take as a wife; आसनम् भज्, to take a seat; रूपम्
भज्, to assume a form; सुखम् (or दुःखम्)
भज्, to experience pleasure (or pain); भयम्
भज्, to feel terror or alarm; मौनम् भज्, to
become silent; मूर्छाम् भज्, to fall into a swoon,
faint away; शयनम् भज्, to go to bed, lie
down to rest; दिशो भज्, to flee in all directions,
run away: Caus. भाजयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अभी-
भजत्, अबभाजत्, to cause to share, give any one
(acc.) a share of anything (gen. or acc., Ved.);
to divide; to cause to go towards, cause to flee,
put to flight, pursue; (according to Vopa-deva) to
cook: Desid. बिभक्षति, -ते: Intens. बाभज्यते,
बाभक्ति; [cf. Gr. φώγω, φώγνυμι: perhaps Lat.
fa-mulus, familia: Goth. anda-bahti, bahtjan:
Angl. Sax. bacan: Old Germ. bachan: Hib.
[]
fuighim, ‘I get, obtain;’ fuigheall, ‘profit, gain,
remainder;’ faghail, ‘getting, finding, obtaining.’]

भाज्, क्, क्, क्, (usually at the end of comps.)
sharing, a sharer; sharing in, participating in, par-
taking of; entitled to; possessing, a possessor, ob-
taining, having, enjoying [cf. रिक्थ-भ्˚, मोक्ष-
भ्˚, स्वप्न-भ्˚]; perceiving, feeling, being sensible
of, devoting one's self to; forming a part of, be-
longing to (Ved.); joined or connected with; occu-
pying (as a seat, place), inhabiting, living in, dwelling
in or on [cf. विष्टर-भ्˚, हर्म्य-भ्˚, यमुना-
भ्˚]; seeking, resorting to, going to, (अङ्क-भाज्,
going to the side or to close proximity, close at hand,
soon to be accomplished); flowing to; revering,
worshipping (e. g. अनन्य-भाज्, worshipping no
other); honouring [cf. लब्ध-वर्ण-भ्˚]; falling
to the share or lot of; what is due, duty, concern,
business, (Bhaṭṭi-k. III. 21 = कर्तव्य.)
भाज् भाज्, भाजन, &c. See col. 1.

भजक, अस्, m. an apportioner, distributer [cf.
चीवर-भ्˚]; one who serves or worships, a wor-
shipper.

भाजक, अस्, m. (fr. Caus. of rt. भज्), dividing;
(in arithmetic) a divisor.

भजत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, apportioning, distributing,
dividing; serving, honouring.

भजन, अम्, n. the act of sharing; possession;
serving, service, adoring, adoration, worship, rever-
ing, reverence; the act of waiting or attending upon.
—भजन-ता, f. devotion, adoration.
—भजन-
वारिक, अस्, m. a particular official in a Buddhist
monastery.
—भजनामृत (˚न-अम्˚), अम्, n.,
N. of a work.

भाजन, अम्, n. (fr. the Caus.), the act of sharing,
dividing; (in arithmetic) division; a vessel, cup, pot,
dish, plate, (often found at the end of a comp., e. g.
जल-भ्˚, पान-भ्˚); a particular measure = an
Āḍhaka = 64 Palas; a vessel (metaphorically), a re-
ceptacle for anything, repository, recipient, a place or
person in which anything is collected or in whom
any quality is conspicuous [cf. प्रीति-विश्रम्भ-भ्˚];
a fit person in general, a deserving person, clever or
capable person [cf. पात्र]; the act of representing
or taking the place of, representation; (at the end
of comps.) a representative, deputy, anything which
serves for or is equivalent to (Ved.); भाजनेन, in
[]
place of, in lieu of, instead of; (अस्), m., N. of a man;
the patronymic formed from this N., see Gaṇa Gopa-
vanādi to Pāṇ. II. 4, 67; (अस्, आ, अम्), sharing, par-
ticipating in, entitled to (at the end of comps.); relat-
ing to, belonging to (at the end of comps., Ved.).
—भाजन-ता, f. or भाजन-त्व, अम्, n. the state
of being a vessel or receptacle for anything, the pos-
sessing (of any quality &c.), the being a (fit) vessel,
fitness, worthiness, the being worthy of or entitled
to; a fit object.
—भाजन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved.
a word used in Nirukta IV. 10, XI. 19, XII. 17,
to explain the word भद्र.
—भाजनी-भूत, अस्,
आ, अम्, having become a vessel or receptacle for
anything, i. e. having become a participator in or
possessor of.

भजनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be loved; worthy of
worship, to be adored, adorable, venerable; to be
waited upon.

भजमान, अस्, आ, अम्, apportioning, dividing,
sharing; enjoying, possessing; loving, honouring,
courting; waiting on, serving; fitting, meet, appro-
priate; N. of various princes.

भजि, इस्, m., N. of a prince; (also read भजिन्,
भजिन.)
भाजी, f. rice gruel (= श्राणा).
भजितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = भजनीय.
भजिन्, ई, m., N. of a preceptor.

भाजिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (at the end of comps.) sharing,
participating in; connected with.

भजेन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, worthy of adoration,
adorable.

भज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, divisible, to be divided or
shared; to be worshipped or adored, adorable.

भज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being divided or shared;
being worshipped or adored.

भजेरथ भजेरथ, अस्, m., Ved. (according
to the Pada-pāṭha भजे + अरथ), occurring in
Ṛg-veda X. 66, 2, (a doubtful word.)

भाजयु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. communicating, sharing
with others, generous, liberal.

भाजित, अस्, आ, अम्, shared, divided, distributed,
apportioned, allotted, portioned; (अम्), n. a share,
portion.

भाजक् भाजक्, ind. quickly, swiftly; (pro-
bably incorrectly for ताजक्.)
